sections.heading: Design + Build Services
paragraphs: Founded in 2015 by HGTV’s Boise Boys, Luke Caldwell, Timber + Love is an award-winning boutique team in Boise. We specialize in restoring old homes and preserving their history, alongside designing and building one-of-a-kind new constructions. Committed to integrity and quality, we take a client-focused approach to every project. With our in-house team, we manage every detail from planning to design and construction, ensuring a seamless, streamlined, and exclusive experience.

sections.heading: Our Design + Build Process
paragraphs: Every project is unique, with varying needs and expectations. Our 3-Phase process is meticulously tailored to ensure we meet your specific requirements while maintaining our commitment to excellence. This foundational framework serves as the basis for our tailored approach to ensuring each project is a success, meeting your unique needs and exceeding your expectations.
CONCEPT DEVELOPMENT

We begin by fully understanding your needs and your home’s current layout. Our architect drafts detailed as-builts to set the groundwork for modifications. We conduct thorough inspections for safety and compliance, and gather crucial information, assessing your investment and relevant city codes to prepare effectively for your project.
DESIGN + CONSTRUCTION DEVELOPMENT

Our team fine-tunes architectural plans to match construction standards. Luke and his team select materials and fixtures that combine beauty and functionality. In a ‘Design First Look’ presentation, you’ll review and approve these selections with Luke, making sure they align perfectly with your vision before moving forward.
DESIGN + CONSTRUCTION EXECUTION

We submit the plans to permitting to secure all necessary construction approvals, and strategically source and procure materials, focusing on cost-effective options. Our team strictly oversees construction, ensuring subcontractors meet deadlines while also conducting thorough quality checks to address any issues and guarantee successful project completion.

sections.heading: OUR VALUES
paragraphs: At Timber + Love, we’re dedicated to transforming dreams into reality with client-centered service. From designing and renovating personalized homes to crafting innovative new constructions, our commitment to excellence ensures each project exceeds expectations. Rooted in love and care for people, family, relationships, and community, we enrich and elevate the places we call home. By preserving Boise’s historical homes and fostering community relationships, we uphold a legacy of homes that reflect our deep-seated values of integrity, quality craftsmanship, and unwavering client satisfaction.
